Criterion: Verify that maintenance manuals require system operational testing for normal/emergency system operation when systems are affected by removal/replacement of components. Standard: Operational tests are performed to ensure system performance when components are removed/replaced that are critical to the operation of the air vehicle system. The maintenance manuals detail the operational tests required to ensure safe system performance following removal/replacement of air vehicle system components. Method of Compliance: Verify by analysis, test, and demonstration that the maintenance manuals contain the operational test(s) required to ensure safe system performance following the removal/replacement of air vehicle system components. Testing instructions have undergone a quality assurance check, and the check and the content of operational testing instructions have been verified by the Government. References: JSSG-2000: 3.6.1, 3.6.2 JSSG-2001: 3.1.5 14 CFR Part 23 Appendix G; Part 25, Appendix H

Standard: Maintenance publications include procedures for operational, functional, and system tests and identify support equipment, supplies, and tools to perform the test. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Examination.
(1) Examine the maintenance publications to ensure they include operational, functional, or system test procedures and performance parameters for testable items that have an impact to AW.
(2) Examine the artifacts that demonstrate contractor certification or contractor validation to ensure the maintenance publications have undergone a quality check for currency and accuracy IAW TO 00-5-3, Contractor Certification Process and Certification Requirements paragraphs for the Air Force; NAVAIR 00-25-604, Contractor Validation Plan and Validation paragraphs for the Navy; and DA PAM 25-40, Validation paragraphs for the Army. Analysis.
  (1) Conduct a FMECA to determine if failure of testable items have an impact to AW. Demonstration.
    (1) Perform air vehicle maintainability demonstrations to confirm the operational, functional, and system tests are complete, accurate, and can be performed as written without introducing AW hazards. Maintenance publications will receive updates to address maintenance issues discovered during maintainability demonstrations. Prior to entering operational test or operations, verify the standard by the following method(s): Demonstration.
    (2) Perform all air vehicle operational, functional, and system test procedures on production-configured hardware using government maintenance personnel to ensure procedures do not introduce AW hazards.
